<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND INC. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THE SHARES OF
SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND INC. HAVE NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT, OR REGISTERED OR QUALIFIED UNDER THE SECURITIES LAWS OF ANY STATES OR OTHER JURISDICTIONS, AND ARE BEING OFFERED AND SOLD IN RELIANCE ON EXEMPTIONS FROM THE
REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS OF THE SECURITIES ACT AND THE REGISTRATION AND QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS OF SUCH LAWS. THE SHARES ARE SUBJECT TO CERTAIN RESTRICTIONS ON TRANSFERABILITY AND RESALE AND MAY NOT BE TRANSFERRED OR RESOLD EXCEPT AS PERMITTED
UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT AND SUCH LAWS PURSUANT TO REGISTRATION, QUALIFICATION OR EXEMPTION THEREFROM. IN ADDITION, HEDGING TRANSACTIONS INVOLVING THE SHARES MAY NOT BE CONDUCTED UNLESS IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE SECURITIES ACT, AND THE SHARES ARE
SUBJECT TO THE CONTRACTUAL RESTRICTIONS ON RESALES DESCRIBED IN THIS SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT. THE SHARES HAVE NOT BEEN APPROVED OR DISAPPROVED BY THE SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION OR BY ANY STATE OR OTHER SECURITIES COMMISSION OR OTHER
REGULATORY AUTHORITY, NOR HAVE ANY OF THE FOREGOING AUTHORITIES PASSED UPON OR ENDORSED THE MERITS OF THIS OFFERING OR THE ACCURACY OR ADEQUACY OF THE OFFERING MATERIALS, AND ANY REPRESENTATION TO THE CONTRARY IS UNLAWFUL. POTENTIAL INVESTORS
RECEIVING THIS SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT ACKNOWLEDGE AND AGREE THAT SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND INC. IS CURRENTLY INTENDED FOR U.S. PERSONS (AS DEFINED IN REGULATION S UNDER THE U.S. SECURITIES ACT OF 1933) ONLY, AND THE SHARES ARE INTENDED TO BE
OFFERED, SOLD, MARKETED, RECOMMENDED AND DISTRIBUTED ONLY TO U.S. PERSONS AND SOLELY WITHIN THE UNITED STATES. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sagard Private Income Fund Inc. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">280 Park Avenue, 34th Floor
West </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">New York, New York 10017 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Ladies and Gentlemen: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Subscription Agreement is being executed and delivered in connection with the subscription by the undersigned to purchase the dollar
amount of Shares of the Company set forth next to the Subscriber&#8217;s signature on the Subscriber Signature Page to the Investor Questionnaire (which amount is hereby incorporated by reference into this Subscription Agreement). Capitalized terms
used herein shall have the same meanings herein as defined in the Company&#8217;s Confidential Private Placement Memorandum (as amended, restated and/or supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, and including the documents incorporated
by reference therein, the &#8220;<U>Memorandum</U>&#8221;), unless otherwise defined herein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For purposes of these Subscription
Documents, the &#8220;Subscriber&#8221; is the person or entity for whose account the Shares will be purchased and that can satisfy the representations and warranties set forth in the Subscription Documents. Another person or entity with investment
authority may complete and execute the Subscription Documents on behalf of the Subscriber but must indicate the capacity in which it is doing so and the name of the Subscriber. The Investor Questionnaire is incorporated by reference into this
Subscription Agreement and forms an integral part hereof. Execution of the Subscriber Signature Page in the Investor Questionnaire constitutes execution of this Subscription Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Subscription</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)
The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that this subscription is subject to acceptance by the Company in its sole discretion. Once accepted by the Company, this subscription becomes irrevocable, unconditional and binding on the part of the
Subscriber. The Subscriber has received, reviewed, and agrees to be bound by, the terms and provisions of this Subscription Agreement, the Memorandum, the Company&#8217;s bylaws (as amended and/or restated from time to time, the
&#8220;<U>Bylaws</U>&#8221;), the Company&#8217;s articles of incorporation (as amended and/or restated from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Charter</U>&#8221;), the investment advisory agreement by and between the Adviser and the Company (as amended
and/or restated from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Advisory Agreement</U>&#8221;) and the Administration Agreement by and between the Company and Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC, in its capacity as the administrator (the
&#8220;<U>Administrator</U>&#8221;) (as amended and/or restated from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Administration Agreement</U>&#8221;). These documents (collectively, the &#8220;<U>Operative Documents</U>&#8221;) are available to the public, free of
charge, on the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission&#8217;s (the &#8220;<U>SEC</U>&#8221;) public EDGAR website. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Subscriber
irrevocably subscribes for and agrees to purchase Shares for the aggregate purchase price set forth on the Subscriber Signature Page of the Investor Questionnaire. This amount is hereby incorporated by reference into this Subscription Agreement.
Payment is due under the terms and conditions set forth herein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) In making investment decisions, the Subscriber should rely
exclusively on: (i)&nbsp;information contained in the Operative Documents, and (ii)&nbsp;reports and other documents the Company files under the U.S. Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Exchange Act</U>&#8221;), from time to
time. This Subscription Agreement is separate from agreements with other investors. The sale of Shares to the Subscriber is distinct from any sale(s) of Shares to other investors. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Acceptance of Subscription; Closings</U>. This Subscription Agreement is subject to
the following terms and conditions: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Company reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to accept or reject the
Subscriber&#8217;s subscription, in whole or in part, at any time and for any reason, including, but not limited to, (i)&nbsp;the Subscriber&#8217;s inability to meet the standards set by Rule 506(b) of Regulation D under the U.S. Securities Act of
1933, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Securities Act</U>&#8221;), as promulgated by the SEC, (ii)&nbsp;the Subscriber&#8217;s inability to meet the standards set by applicable state securities laws or (iii)&nbsp;for any other reason or for no reason. The
Subscriber acknowledges that submission of this Subscription Agreement does not obligate the Company to accept the subscription. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, the Subscriber may void this Subscription Agreement by
providing written notice to the Company no later than two business days prior to the Closing (as defined below). The Subscriber acknowledges that failure to provide such written notice by the specified deadline will, to the fullest extent permitted
by law, be deemed waiver of this right. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) If the Subscriber&#8217;s subscription is accepted in part and rejected in part: (i)&nbsp;the
Company will notify the Subscriber of the accepted amount upon receipt of the Company Acceptance of Subscription, (ii)&nbsp;the Subscriber agrees to deliver promptly, upon the Company&#8217;s request, a new Subscriber Signature Page to the Investor
Questionnaire reflecting the accepted amount, and (iii)&nbsp;in the event of any whole or partial rejection of the subscription, the Company will return the applicable amount of any submitted funds to the Subscriber, without interest or deduction.
The Company shall not be liable for any loss or expense incurred by the Subscriber as a result of any such rejection. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The closing of
the Subscriber&#8217;s subscription and commitment to purchase Shares (the &#8220;<U>Closing</U>&#8221;) will occur when, (i)&nbsp;the Subscriber has fully completed and executed the Subscription Documents, (ii)&nbsp;the Subscriber has made their
capital contribution, and (iii)&nbsp;the Company has accepted the subscription (the date of such acceptance, which shall be indicated on the Company Acceptance of Subscription provided to the Subscriber, will be the &#8220;<U>Closing
Date</U>&#8221;). On the Closing Date, the Subscriber shall be registered as a holder of the Shares (a &#8220;<U>Shareholder</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) The Company intends to conduct closings for Shares on a monthly basis. The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to conduct
closings more or less frequently for one or more investors. The Company may adjust the frequency of closings for regulatory, tax or other reasons it deems appropriate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) If the Company permits the Subscriber to make an additional purchase of Shares after accepting its initial subscription, the Subscriber
will be required, at the election of the Company in its sole discretion, to either (i)&nbsp;enter into an addendum to this Subscription Agreement, or (ii)&nbsp;execute a new subscription agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Share Issuance</U>. The Company will issue Shares to the Subscriber (and credit them to the Subscriber&#8217;s account) following a
Closing and upon receipt of the aggregate purchase price. The number of Shares issued will be calculated by dividing (a)&nbsp;the aggregate purchase price for the Shares paid by the Subscriber and accepted by the Company by (b)&nbsp;the then-current
transaction price per Share. The then-current transaction price per Share will generally be equal to the NAV per Share as of the last calendar day of the month immediately preceding the Closing Date, as determined in accordance with the
Company&#8217;s share pricing policy and the Adviser&#8217;s valuation policy. The Company will publicly disclose the applicable NAV following the Closing Date, typically via a current report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">8-K</FONT> filed
with the SEC. Please refer to the Memorandum for more information. The Company shall not be liable to the Subscriber for any fluctuation in NAV between the date of submission of the subscription and the applicable Closing Date. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. <U>Distribution</U><U>s; </U><U>Distribution</U><U> Reinvestment Plan</U>. The Company&#8217;s distribution reinvestment plan, as may be
amended or modified from time to time (the &#8220;<U>Distribution</U><U> Reinvestment Plan</U>&#8221;), provides that all cash distributions declared by the Company&#8217;s board of directors shall be reinvested in accordance with the terms of the
Distribution Reinvestment Plan. The Subscriber may opt out of the Distribution Reinvestment Plan in the Investor Questionnaire. An election to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-out</FONT> or to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-in</FONT> to
the Distribution Reinvestment Plan may be altered in accordance with the Distribution Reinvestment Plan. If the Subscriber elects to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-out</FONT> of the Distribution Reinvestment Plan, cash distributions will be
paid by wiring funds to the Subscriber&#8217;s account as indicated in the Investor Questionnaire or the custodian wiring instructions on </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
file in the books and records of the Transfer Agent. In the event that the Company deposits funds erroneously into the Subscriber&#8217;s account, the Subscriber understands that the Company is
authorized to debit such account for the amount of the erroneous deposit. The Subscriber also acknowledges that funds and/or Shares in its account may be subject to applicable abandoned property, escheat or similar laws and may be transferred to the
appropriate governmental authority in accordance with such laws, including as a result of account inactivity for the period of time specified in such laws or otherwise. Subscriber acknowledges that none of the Company, its affiliates, its agents or
any other person shall be liable for any property delivered in good faith to a governmental authority pursuant to applicable abandoned property, escheat or similar laws. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Representations</U><U>,</U><U> Warranties </U><U>and Covenants </U><U>of the Subscriber</U>. The Subscriber makes the following

document required to be provided under this Subscription Agreement (including the Investor Questionnaire and any Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9</FONT> or Forms <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8</FONT>
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(W-8BEN,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8BEN-E,</FONT></FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8IMY,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8ECI</FONT> or <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-8EXP)),</FONT> as applicable, ceases to be true at any time following the date hereof. To the fullest extent permitted under applicable law, the Subscriber agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Company, the Adviser,
the Administrator and their respective affiliates, and each partner, member, shareholder, officer, trustee, employee and agent thereof (the &#8220;<U>Indemnified Parties</U>&#8221;), from and against any and all losses, damages, liabilities, costs
and expenses (including reasonable attorneys&#8217; fees and investigation costs) due to or arising out of: (a)&nbsp;a breach of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement of the Subscriber contained in this Subscription Agreement
(including the Investor Questionnaire and all other appendices and attachments hereto); (b) any violation of applicable law by the Subscriber; or (c)&nbsp;any other document provided by the Subscriber to the Company or in any agreement executed by
the Subscriber in connection with the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in Shares. This indemnification shall not be limited by the amount of the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">15. <U>Confidentiality</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <U>Definition</U>. &#8220;<U>Confidential Information</U>&#8221; means all <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information
relating to the Company, the Adviser, the Administrator, or their respective affiliates (including any of their respective portfolio companies, proposed investments, investment strategies, business plans, financial information, investor lists, fee
arrangements, and the existence and terms of this Subscription Agreement) that has been or may be furnished to the Subscriber, directly or indirectly, whether in written, oral, electronic, or any other form, in connection with the Subscriber&#8217;s
investment in the Company, including without limitation the Memorandum, all Operative Documents, and all reports, analyses, and evaluations prepared by or on behalf of the Company or the Adviser. Confidential Information does not include information
that: (i)&nbsp;is or becomes generally available to the public other than as a result of disclosure by the Subscriber or any of its representatives in breach of this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;15</U>; (ii) was already known to the Subscriber
prior to disclosure by the Company or the Adviser, as evidenced by written records predating the disclosure; or (iii)&nbsp;is received by the Subscriber from a third party not known to the Subscriber to be under a duty of confidentiality to the
Company with respect to such information. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Confidentiality Obligations</U>. The Subscriber shall, and shall cause its respective
officers, directors, employees, partners, members, advisers (including legal counsel, accountants and financial advisers), agents and representatives (collectively, &#8220;<U>Representatives</U>&#8221;) to: (i)&nbsp;hold all Confidential Information
in strict confidence; (ii)&nbsp;use Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating and </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">15 </P>

</DIV></Center>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
monitoring the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in the Company; (iii)&nbsp;not disclose, reproduce, summarize or otherwise make available any Confidential Information to any person without the
Company&#8217;s prior written consent, except to Representatives of the Subscriber who (A)&nbsp;have a need to know such information solely for the purpose of assisting the Subscriber with its investment in the Company, and (B)&nbsp;are bound by
confidentiality obligations at least as protective of the Company as those set forth in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;15</U>; and (iv)&nbsp;not disclose the existence, nature or economic terms of the Subscriber&#8217;s investment in the Company
to any person without the Company&#8217;s prior written consent. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Pooled Investment Vehicles</U>. If the Subscriber is a pooled
investment fund or vehicle, the Subscriber shall only be permitted to disclose Confidential Information to its investors, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-advisers,</FONT> and investment consultants if (i)&nbsp;such persons are bound by written
confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those set forth in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;15</U>, (ii) such persons are informed that the Confidential Information is confidential and must be kept strictly confidential, and
(iii)&nbsp;the Subscriber remains primarily liable for any breach of this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;15</U> by any such person. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)
<U>Compelled Disclosure</U>. If the Subscriber or any of its Representatives is required or ordered by applicable law, regulation, court order, government authority, regulatory body or self-regulatory organization to disclose any Confidential
Information, the Subscriber shall, to the extent permitted by law: (i)&nbsp;provide the Company with at least ten (10)&nbsp;business days&#8217; prior written notice of such requirement (or, if ten (10)&nbsp;business days&#8217; notice is not
possible, as much notice as is reasonably practicable); (ii) cooperate with the Company (at the Company&#8217;s cost and expense) in seeking a protective order or other appropriate remedy; (iii)&nbsp;disclose only such portion of the Confidential
Information as its counsel advises is legally required to be disclosed; and (iv)&nbsp;use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain assurance that confidential treatment will be accorded to any Confidential Information so disclosed. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) <U>Insider Trading</U>. The Subscriber agrees to comply with all applicable laws, including securities laws, concerning Confidential
Information and agrees that it shall not, and shall cause its Representatives not to, trade in the securities of any issuer about which the Subscriber receives material <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information under this
Subscription Agreement or in its capacity as a holder of Shares, and shall refrain from such trading until such information no longer constitutes material <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> information. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) <U>Notice of Unauthorized Disclosure</U>. The Subscriber shall notify the Company in writing as promptly as practicable, and in any event
within two (2)&nbsp;business days, upon becoming aware of any actual, threatened or suspected unauthorized disclosure of Confidential Information. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) <U>Return or Destruction</U>. Upon the request of the Company at any time, or upon the termination of the Subscriber&#8217;s relationship
with the&nbsp;Company, the Subscriber shall promptly return to the Company or certify in writing the destruction of all Confidential Information (in whatever form held) in the Subscriber&#8217;s or its Representatives&#8217; possession or control,
except to the extent required to be retained by applicable law or regulation or bona fide record retention policies, and except for electronic archival copies retained in accordance with automated backup procedures that are not readily accessible.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) <U>Remedies</U>. The Subscriber acknowledges and agrees that monetary damages would be an inadequate remedy for any breach of this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;15</U> by the Subscriber and that, in addition to any other remedies available to the Company in respect of any such breach, the Company shall be entitled, without the requirement to post a bond or other security, to
specific performance and injunctive or other equitable relief as a remedy for any such breach or threatened breach. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Appendix L </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PRIVACY POLICY </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Privacy Notice (this
&#8220;Notice&#8221;) describes how Sagard Holdings Manager LP, Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC and Sagard Holdings Manager (Canada) Inc. (&#8220;Sagard&#8221;) and certain of their affiliates and delegates (together, &#8220;we,&#8221;
&#8220;us,&#8221; &#8220;our&#8221;) collect, use, share, transfer, store, and protect (&#8220;process&#8221;) personal information (&#8220;personal data&#8221;). Reference to third parties in this Notice refers to those third parties who are
outside of our corporate group (&#8220;Third Parties&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Who This Notice Affects </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Notice directly affects prospective, current, and past individual investors and beneficiaries. If you are a representative of a company or institution
providing us with personal data on individuals for any reason in relation to your investment or business relationship with us, this Notice may be relevant to those individuals. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>The Personal Data We Collect </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We obtain certain
information that constitutes personal data by virtue of your making an investment in Sagard and/or by otherwise engaging with us (e.g. through the initial application process; through electronic communications or phone calls), by virtue of receiving
information on individuals connected with an investor, or through third party sources (including background, credit and regulatory check services). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">While
the personal data we collect may vary depending on the capacity in which you deal with us as an individual, as well as the jurisdiction where you reside, &#8220;personal data,&#8221; as used in this Notice means any information that, either alone or
when combined with other information, identifies or otherwise relates to an individual. Such personal data may include, though is not limited to, name; address; date of birth; identity verification information; governmental identifiers such as
social security/insurance number; citizenship and residency data; anti-money laundering and tax data; asset and liability data; income; investment experience; your beneficiaries and signatories; account information and transaction history. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We may also collect information about you from your interactions with our websites or mobile apps through the placement of cookies, pixels and similar
technologies. This may include your IP address, device information and approximate geolocation obtained from the location of your device when accessing our websites or apps, as well as how you use our websites or apps and any preferences you set
such as region or language. Generally, this information cannot directly identify you (for example, it is not associated with your name.) Note that some browsers may have &#8220;do not track&#8221; settings, but we do not honor such browser settings.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We use Google Analytics to collect and process certain analytics data and analyze your use of our websites. Google Analytics is subject to the Google
Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">L-1 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We may process personal data for the following purposes: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

documents, such as for accounting and administration purposes and to provide our investment products and services; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">for other purposes, with your consent or at your request. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Why We Transfer Personal Data </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We do not sell personal
data. We do not share personal data (including mobile information) with Third Parties for marketing or promotional purposes. We may share personal data with our affiliates to offer products and services that complement your relationship with us; we
will ask for your consent to share this personal data where the law requires it. You may <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">opt-out</FONT> of the foregoing by contacting our Privacy Officer at compliance@sagardholdings.com. We may transfer information
to our affiliates and delegates and third-party service providers (including credit bureaus and background search services in order to accurately identify you if we collect personal data from them, third party fund administrators, investment
managers, depositaries, auditors, professional supervisory firms and advisors such as consultants and legal counsel) for the purposes described in this Notice. In certain circumstances, we may be legally obliged to share personal data with relevant
tax, securities, banking and other regulatory authorities as well as other financial institutions in the various jurisdictions where we operate. We may also share personal data as required or allowed by law, including in connection with
investigation and establishment of our legal rights, in connection with the sale or reorganization or all or a portion of Sagard, and as otherwise described in this Notice. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The administrator or manager for a particular Sagard fund (the &#8220;<B>Administrator/Manager</B>&#8221;) may use personal data where necessary for
compliance with a legal obligation to which it is directly subject, such as to comply with applicable law in the area of anti-money laundering and counter terrorist financing, where required for global tax reporting purposes, or where mandated by a
court order or regulatory sanction. The Administrator/Manager, with respect to this specific use of personal data, acts as a data controller. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">L-2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The depositary for a particular Sagard fund (the &#8220;<B>Depositary</B>&#8221;) is also a separate
controller of the personal data of holders of interests or shares, applicants for interests or shares, beneficial owners, and directors and officers of holders of interests or shares. Such personal data may be processed by the Depositary to the
extent that it is necessary to comply with its own obligations, including under anti-money laundering legislation and in the discharge of its statutory oversight and monitoring obligations. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This sharing of data may involve transfer of data across domestic or international borders, and we may share personal data to meet international compliance
obligations and consistent with the purposes explained in this Notice. Where data about persons in the EU are shared outside the EEA or a third country where the European Commission has not issued a finding of adequacy regarding data protection, any
necessary and appropriate standard contractual clauses or other compliance mechanisms will protect the processing of personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Data Protection Measures </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We intend to safeguard data we
hold or process and maintain physical, electronic and administrative controls to safeguard personal information about current, former and prospective investors; nonetheless, no method of data storage or transmission is completely secure, and we do
not guarantee the security of data. If you believe your personal data may have been compromised, please contact us immediately. We shall notify you of any personal data breach consistent with applicable legal requirements. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Data Protection Rights </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Data protection laws provide
certain rights regarding the use of personal data. We will honor those rights as appropriate under applicable law and will review and respond to other requests with respect to personal data. The potentially applicable rights vary by jurisdiction and
may include rights to access data, examine and correct data, data portability, restrict the use of data, withdraw consent given to the processing of data, receive information regarding certain entities to whom we disclose personal data; and to lodge
a complaint with an applicable data protection regulator. Please note that the right for data to be erased (the &#8220;right to be forgotten&#8221;) that applies in some jurisdictions and in certain contexts is not likely to be applicable to most,
if not all, of the personal data we hold, given the specific nature of the purposes for which we use the data and applicable regulatory and accounting requirements that require us to maintain appropriate books and records. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If you want to exercise any of these rights, please submit a written request using the contact information provided below. In your request, please make clear:
(i)&nbsp;what personal data is concerned and (ii)&nbsp;which of the above rights you want to enforce. For your protection, we may need to verify your identity and the identity of any agent purporting to act on your behalf before responding. We will
comply with your request in a reasonably prompt manner, but in any event within the legally mandated timeframes unless an extension of that timeframe is appropriate. We do not and will not discriminate against anyone who exercises any of the
abovementioned rights. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Privacy Complaints </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Data
Subjects and their legal representatives may submit privacy-related complaints to Sagard. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">L-3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sagard is committed to responding to all such complaints in a timely and appropriate manner. An initial
written acknowledgment will be provided within five (5)&nbsp;business days of receipt of the complaint. All complaints will be addressed and closed within ninety (90)&nbsp;days of receipt. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The process for handling privacy complaints includes the following steps: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

acknowledge receipt, request any additional information, and clarify the outcome being sought. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

created for each complaint. This file will include the original complaint, any additional materials provided, Sagard&#8217;s analysis, and the final written response. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

Commission d&#8217;acc&egrave;s &agrave; l&#8217;information (CAI) should they wish to pursue the matter further. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sagard prohibits any
form of reprisal against individuals who, in good faith, submit a complaint to the CAI or cooperate with a CAI investigation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Retention of Personal
Data </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We have internal policies and procedures governing the use, protection, retention and destruction of personal data throughout our relationship
with you. We may retain personal data for a period of eight years following disinvestment or the point where your business relationship with us has ceased. Thereafter, we shall take appropriate steps to anonymize or dispose of any records containing
personal data, unless further retention is required by applicable legal obligation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Updates to this Notice </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Privacy Notice was last updated on September 18, 2026. We may change this Notice at any time and will notify investors of material changes. A current copy
of the Privacy Notice will be posted on our websites. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Getting in Touch </B></P>

compliance@sagardholdings.com. </P>

<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>BHC Investor</U>&#8221; is defined as a Subscriber that is a bank holding company, as defined in
Section&nbsp;2(a) of the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended (the &#8220;<U>BHC Act</U>&#8221;), a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-bank</FONT> subsidiary (for purposes of the BHC Act) of a bank holding company, a foreign banking
organization, as defined in Regulation K of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (12 C.F.R. &#167; 211.23) or any successor regulation, or a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-bank</FONT> subsidiary (for purposes of the BHC Act) of
a foreign banking organization which subsidiary is engaged, directly or indirectly in business in the United States and which in any case holds Shares for its own account. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">2</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>Benefit Plan Investor</U>&#8221; is (a)&nbsp;any &#8220;employee benefit plan,&#8221; as defined
in, and subject to Title I of ERISA; (b)&nbsp;any plan subject to Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code; and (c)&nbsp;any entity deemed for any purpose of ERISA or Section&nbsp;4975 of the Code to hold assets of any of the investors described in (a)&nbsp;or
(b) (i.e., generally because other Benefit Plan Investors hold 25% or more of one or more classes of equity in such entity). Benefit Plan Investors include, but are not limited to, corporate pension and profit-sharing plans, Keogh plans and IRAs. A
Benefit Plan Investor can also be an insurance-company general account, the assets of which are considered for purposes of ERISA to be assets of a Benefit Plan Investor. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">3</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">For purposes of this representation, an &#8220;affiliate&#8221; is any person controlling, controlled by or
under common control with any such person, including by reason of having the power to exercise a controlling influence over the management or policies of such person. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">4</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">As defined in Rule 902(k) of Regulation S under the Securities Act, a &#8220;U.S. person&#8221; means:
(i)&nbsp;any natural person resident in the United States; (ii)&nbsp;any partnership or corporation organized or incorporated under the laws of the United States; (iii)&nbsp;any estate of which any executor or administrator is a U.S. person;
(iv)&nbsp;any trust of which any trustee is a U.S. person; (v)&nbsp;any agency or branch of a foreign entity located in the United States; (vi)&nbsp;any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-discretionary</FONT> account or similar account (other than
an estate or trust) held by a dealer or other fiduciary for the benefit or account of a U.S. person; (vii)&nbsp;any discretionary account or similar account (other than an estate or trust) held by a dealer or other fiduciary organized, incorporated,
or (if an individual) resident in the United States; and (viii)&nbsp;any partnership or corporation if (A)&nbsp;organized or incorporated under the laws of any foreign jurisdiction and (B)&nbsp;formed by a U.S. person principally for the purpose of
investing in securities not registered under the Securities Act, unless it is organized or incorporated, and owned, by accredited investors (as defined in Rule 501(a) under the Securities Act) who are not natural persons, estates, or trusts.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>
